question: Why did Isaiah cry, 'Woe to me! I am ruined!'?
options: Because he was a man of unclean lips and had seen the King, the LORD Almighty
Because the temple was on fire
Because the seraphim were angry with him
explanation: In Isaiah 6:5 Isaiah said he was a man of unclean lips living among a people of unclean lips, and his eyes had seen the King, the LORD Almighty.
